events.title: 2026年金球獎頒發 凱恩首度榮膺男子金球獎

events.summary: 33歲英格蘭前鋒凱恩（Harry Kane）榮獲2026年男子金球獎，終結英格蘭球員長達25年的金球獎等待。凱恩力壓姆巴佩與亞馬爾奪下最高個人榮譽，他在2025至2026年賽季代表拜仁慕尼黑與英格蘭代表隊出賽65場，總計攻入驚人的73球，並以91球位居英格蘭隊史進球榜首。

【BBC Sport】Image source, Getty Images Image caption, Kane won the Ballon d'Or on Monday night Chief football writer Published 27 October 2026 Harry Kane has taken the scenic route to the Ballon d'Or - a road littered with doubts and diversions, but one that eventually led to the ultimate destination: being crowned as the world's best player. The 33-year-old's glory at the London Palladium on Monday is fitting reward for an exemplary career that has seen records fall at his feet for England, Tottenham Hotspur and Bayern Munich. Kane is England's top goalscorer with 91 goals. He has 125 England caps, joint-highest with Peter Shilton. He is Spurs' record scorer with 280 goals in 435 appearances. He scored a remarkable 73 goals in 65 games for Bayern Munich and England during the 2025â26 season. This is the Kane of recent vintage, the world-class striker and complete footballer who beat Real Madrid and France striker Kylian Mbappe, as well as Spain's teenage Barcelona forward Lamine Yamal, to the sport's biggest personal honour. Kane's humility has seen him described as an 'anti-superstar' and his achievement has been commended both inside and outside the football world. One post on social media from Kane as he celebrated the greatest moment of his career said it all: "Work hard in silence. Let success be your noise." And yet, Kane's journey was not always smooth. It was one that started with loan moves around the lower divisions with Leyton Orient, Millwall, Norwich City and Leicester City before he developed into a great for club and country. The same Kane sat on the bench on loan at Leicester City â alongside future England team-mate Jamie Vardy â when the Foxes lost a dramatic Championship play-off at Watford in May 2013. Kane went through hard schools and hard times away from his more familiar environment at Spurs, joining Orient on loan as a 17-year-old in January 2011, playing 18 games with nine starts and scoring five goals.
